lineas.texto: You wake up in the year 1300. This time you are fourteen, a squire in a castle.
You sleep on a straw mattress in the great hall, next to the other boys and the dogs.
Before your knight wakes up, you check his horse: water, hay, and clean hooves.
Then his armour. His mail is made of thousands of little iron rings, linked by hand.
Iron rusts, so you clean it the old way: rolled in a barrel of sand and vinegar.
You help him dress. A padded coat first, then the heavy mail, then the cloth coat on top.
At dinner, you serve at your lord's table. You even carve his meat.
And the plates? Thick slices of old bread, called trenchers.
